## Houston 0.6.21

### New integration: ManyChat

- **Connect ManyChat from the curated integrations list**, so your agents can work with your chat marketing right away.

### Custom integrations you set up yourself

- **Sign in to a custom integration with your own account** when the service supports it, instead of hunting for an API key.
- **Give a custom integration your own name and icon**, so it looks right alongside the rest.

### More room to read

- **Mission chats open in a wider view**, so long answers are easier to follow.

### Fixes and polish

- **Connecting a model on your own computer tells you the truth**, with honest wording instead of an endless wait.
- **The restart to update button is easier to spot.**
- **Very long conversations keep working**, and a heavy task no longer takes the agent down with it.
- **A dropped connection no longer reads as a failed answer**, and an expired session recovers on its own.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
